system.boundary: Build a Simulink model of a hybrid analog/digital massive-MIMO communication link that simultaneously carries two independent 16-QAM spatial streams through a scattering channel.

physical_paths: Build a Simulink model of a hybrid analog/digital massive-MIMO communication link that simultaneously carries two independent 16-QAM spatial streams through a scattering channel.
The transmitter shall use 64 antenna elements through four RF chains, and the receiver shall use 16 antenna elements through four RF chains.
ChannelMatrix contains the complex normalized 16-by-64 physical channel used for beamforming.
